text: Binary judgment on the OP's own argument text (column "argument", current text including marked edits): 1 if, in the OP's own voice, the conclusion is framed as the only possible or inevitable one and alternative perspectives are neither acknowledged nor treated as legitimate; 0 otherwise, including when alternatives are explicitly acknowledged or the argument is merely confident or one-sided without framing the conclusion as the only possible one. Quoted or reported opponents' positions don't count as the OP's framing. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting the outcome (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered). Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
